entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-tx-r4-sur-v0#1
entries.description: [tx-r4-sur] an output whose R4 is the String ⟨ED A0 80⟩. The JVM reads it as ONE U+FFFD and writes `EF BF BD`, so the transaction it writes, and the id it computes over those bytes, are tx-ctl-r4-repl's. SEPARATING: a port that keeps the bytes, or decodes three replacements, writes other bytes and computes another id: a wrong transaction id is a wrong block. The JVM's id: 5e2cec6f0eb46b55ca37a1b3f2cbd48c5e480648e0a353dbbfa5a4cdcc3525a1.
